Rhys Roberts (1858-1929), Professor of Greek at Bangor and of Classics at Leeds, raw IA OCR: The Ancient Boeotians: their Character and Culture, and their Reputation (Cambridge: at the University Press, 1895); Patriotic Poetry, Greek and English, an address given on the 500th anniversary of Agincourt (1916); and Greek Rhetoric and Literary Criticism (Our Debt to Greece and Rome; New York: Longmans, Green, 1928; US public domain by date). His editions of Longinus, Demetrius and Dionysius are on those authors' shelves. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dy). No uids minted.
